name: chunk-border
comment: Light crossing the x=15|16 chunk boundary (chunks (0,0) and (1,0)): a stone floor at y=60 over x=10..21, z=2..12, an opaque stone roof at y=64 spanning x=14..18, z=4..8, and glowstone (89) at (15,62,6) under it, placed at t=0 (set_block). Sky light under the roof and block light from the glowstone both have to cross the chunk edge through the light queue.
